now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 41, Deathlok secretly works for Coulson and helps take down HYDRA's Dr. List.

proposed.text: In episode 41, Deathlok, secretly working for Coulson, has been captured while hunting HYDRA's Dr. List, and Coulson's team frees him from List's base.

changes.evidence: Peterson does not help take down List. In episode 40 (The Frenemy of My Enemy) Hydra captures Peterson and Lincoln; in episode 41 (The Dirty Half Dozen) Simmons and Ward save Peterson, List is not defeated, and the base intel goes to Maria Hill for the Avengers.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot
now.text: In episode 3, Simmons and Fitz upgrade Elena's tracking watch, and a question from Elena about living together gets Simmons thinking.

proposed.text: In episode 3, Simmons checks Elena's pulse while Fitz upgrades her tracking watch, and Elena's suggestion that they look for an apartment gets Simmons hooked on the idea.

changes.evidence: In Slingshot episode 3 (Progress), Simmons checks Elena's pulse and Fitz upgrades the watch; Fitz and Simmons are already arguing about a TV in their bedroom, and Elena's distraction is suggesting they look for an apartment, which Simmons leaves intrigued by.

owner_calls.question: Season 7 record (k 4) keeps status Deceased, but the finale shows a Life Model Decoy of Davis active a year later, driving Piper and Elena on missions. Should the last status reflect the LMD?
options: Keep Deceased (the man died; the LMD is a copy)
Change to Active (the title leaves an LMD Davis active in S.H.I.E.L.D.)
owner_calls.evidence: What We're Fighting For: Elena is in a car with Piper and an LMD of Davis on a mission one year later; Piper keeps arguing with the LMD Davis about his driving.
